text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Seri Pahlawan Gagah
Perkasa (Remembrance Allowance) Act 1990.

2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires—

"child" includes a step-child and a child adopted,
before the death of the recipient, under any written
law, custom or usage;

"Decoration" means the Decoration of Seri
Pahlawan Gagah Perkasa conferred under the Statutes
of Seri Pahlawan Gagah Perkasa (S.P.);

"Minister" means the Prime Minister;

"recipient" means any person who has been
conferred the Decoration;

"remembrance allowance" means the remembrance
allowance granted under subsection (1) of section 3;

"spouse" means the widow or widower of a deceased
recipient whose marriage is recognized in Malaysia as a
valid marriage under any written law, religion, custom
or usage.

3. (1) There may be granted to a recipient a
remembrance allowance of two hundred ringgit per
month, and where the Decoration is conferred on such
recipient more than once, there may be granted to him
a separate remembrance allowance of two hundred
ringgit per month in respect of each Decoration
conferred on him, such allowance being payable in
arrear not earlier than the end of each month.

(2) Where the Decoration was conferred before the
commencement of this Act and the recipient is living
upon such commencement, the remembrance
allowance shall be paid retrospectively to the recipient,
commencing with the month in which the Decoration
was conferred on him, but not earlier, in any case, than
the month of June 1983.

(3) Where the Decoration is conferred after the
commencement of this Act, the remembrance
allowance shall be paid to the recipient monthly in
alrear, commencing with the month in which the
Decoration is conferred on him.

4. (1) The grant of a remembrance allowance shall
cease—

(a) upon the death of the recipient;

(b) upon the recipient being convicted for an
offence by a court of law in the Federation and
sentenced to death, or to imprisonment for
any term otherwise than imprisonment in lieu
of payment of fine; or

(c) upon cancellation or annullment of the
conferment of the Decoration in accordance
with section VIII of the Statutes of Seri
Pahlawan Gagah Perkasa,

and no remembrance allowance shall be paid
commencing with the month in which the death takes
place, or the sentence is imposed, or the conferment of
the Decoration is cancelled or annulled, as the case
may be.

(S. 4-5)

SERI PAHLAWAN GAGAH PERKASA            7

(REMEMBRANCE ALLOWANCE)

(2) If the recipient receives a free pardon in respect
of the said conviction, or if the cancelled or annulled
Decoration is restored to him, the remembrance
allowance shall be restored to him commencing from
the month in which the free pardon is received or the
restoration of the Decoration is made.

5, (1) Where the Decoration had been conferred
posthumously before the commencement of this Act,
there may be made a grant of a total sum of twenty
thousand ringgit once only—

(a) to the spouse or spouses and children of the
deceased recipient who are living on the date
of the commencement of this Act;

(b) if there is on such date no such spouse or child
living, to his parents or parent living on such
date; or

(c) if there is on such date no such parent living, to
his grandparents or grandparent living on such
date.

(2) Where the Decoration is conferred posthu-
mously after the commencement of this Act, there may

be made a grant of a total sum of twenty thousand ringgit
once only—

(a) to the spouse or spouses and children of the
deceased recipient who are living on the date
of the conferment of the Decoration;

(b) if there is on such date no such spouse or child
living, to his parents or parent living on such
date; or

(c) if there is on such date no parent living, to his
grandparents or grandparent living on such
date.

6. Where the Decoration was conferred before the
commencement of this Act and the recipient had died
before such commencement, there may be made a
grant of a total sum of twenty thousand ringgit once
only—

(a) to the spouse or spouses and children of the
deceased recipient who are living on the date
of the commencement of this Act;

(b) ifthere is on such date no such spouse or child
living, to his parents or parent living on such
date; or

(c) ifthere is on such date no such parent living, to
his grandparents or grandparent living on such
date.

7. The amounts to be paid to the spouse or spouses,
children, parents or grandparents, as the case may be,
under section 5 or 6 shall be in such proportions as may
be determined by the Minister.

8. The remembrance allowances and sums granted
under this Act shall be charged on the Federal
Consolidated Fund.

9. Any remembrance allowance or sum granted under
this Act shall not be assignable or transferable, or liable
to be attached, sequestrated or levied upon in respect
of any claim.
